run_grpc_tests: run grpc tests in parallel for a specified language with configurable compiler and build options
run_tests_with_docker: run grpc tests under docker for isolated environment with language-specific prerequisites
run_tests_forever: run grpc tests in an infinite loop watching for file changes in source directories
run_tests_with_flake_detection: run grpc tests allowing flaky tests to pass by re-running failed tests up to five times
run_tests_with_bq_upload: run grpc tests and upload results to a specified BigQuery table for historical analysis
